blurb:
You're not just hiring a photographer—you're choosing someone who wants your San Francisco photo session to be one of the highlights of your trip. Whether you're celebrating a surprise proposal, engagement, family vacation, anniversary, or simply exploring the city, I'll help create an experience that's relaxed, enjoyable, and uniquely yours. As a local photographer, I'll recommend the ideal location based on the season, lighting, and your vision—from the Golden Gate Bridge and Baker Beach to Crissy Field, the Palace of Fine Arts, and other hidden gems. 

Clients often tell me they arrived feeling nervous but left saying, "That was fun." That's exactly what I hope you'll say too. My goal isn't just to deliver beautiful photographs—it's to create an experience and memories you'll treasure long after your visit to San Francisco.
